question: On the printer's screen, open Settings. Is there an entry called Root account information?

reason: This printer has no root option. Some 2025 K1C units ship without it, and the installer cannot put HelixScreen on them.

text: Before you start: the installer first puts Simple AF, a community firmware, on this printer, then HelixScreen. Going back to Creality's own software later takes a factory reset or Creality's recovery firmware; removing only HelixScreen is quick and leaves Simple AF's screen. Simple AF's installer turns off certificate checking for git on the printer, and it stays off.
Turn on root access: on the printer's screen open Settings, then Root account information. Read the notice, wait for the countdown, then press OK. Then press I've done this.

reason: This installer supports the Creality K1, K1C and K1 Max only, and this printer says it is another model.
Simple AF needs Creality firmware 1.3.3.5 or newer. Update the printer from its own screen, then run the installer again.

ssh: if [ -d /usr/data/helper-script ] || [ -f /usr/data/fluidd.sh ] || [ -f /usr/data/mainsail.sh ] || { [ -d /opt ] && [ ! -L /opt ] && [ -n "$(ls -1 /opt)" ]; }; then echo yes; else echo no; fi

reason: Something from an earlier mod is on this printer (Helper Script, Creality's Fluidd or Mainsail script, or files in /opt). Simple AF installs only on a printer fresh from a factory reset: reset it from its Settings, then run the installer again.
